title: Named Counterparty Relation Evidence v1
description: Reviewed annual-report evidence for period-bounded company relations. Source availability, independent identity availability, and relation-review availability are kept separate.

report_period_start.description: First date covered by the disclosed transaction amount.

report_period_end.description: Last date covered by the disclosed transaction amount.

announcement_time.description: Official announcement timestamp of the transaction filing.

source_available_time.description: Earliest verified local availability of the transaction filing.

identity_available_time.description: Earliest verified local availability of the independent identity filing.

reviewed_at.description: Time at which the page layout, quote, direction, amount, and identity were reviewed.

relation_available_time.description: Earliest model availability of the reviewed relation; not earlier than source, identity, or review availability.

const: transaction quote contains the disclosed counterparty name and exact amount
independent identity quote contains the counterparty legal name and security code
both company identifiers already exist in the enterprise registry
page layout and column alignment are visually verified
relation_available_time is not earlier than source, identity, or review availability
relation valid_to is the day after report_period_end and does not imply continuation
